set.body:
Goal
Use all four study presentations without inventing cross-presentation saccades or privileging presentation 4.

Implementation
Align retrieval independently to each study episode and combine the four candidate compatibilities as an equal-prior likelihood mixture after applying the same calibrated energy scale. Keep per-episode alignments for diagnostics and cache prepared reference measures.

Acceptance criteria
- Four presentations are never concatenated and no temporal relation crosses an episode boundary.
- Reordering the four study rows leaves item evidence unchanged.
- The one-episode case reduces numerically to the single-template Transport contract.
- Missing or invalid episodes follow a declared renormalization rule and emit provenance.
- Equal prior weights are fixed by design; outcome-driven episode weighting is prohibited.
- Candidate ranking, information bits, and per-episode diagnostics have deterministic tests.
- Runtime and memory scale are benchmarked for 1-4 episodes and exhaustive candidate pools.
set.title: GW-18.3 Add equal-prior multi-presentation episode Transport
